device_entry.name: LabRAD Twisted连接组件
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
分布式实验控制与远程过程调用
device_entry.description: 一个非物理的软件连接组件，用于与LabRAD管理器建立和维护同步连接、派生新连接、创建通信上下文，并向目标服务发送请求或消息。它主要用于实验控制软件中的服务发现、设置查询和进程间通信，而不是直接控制某台实体仪器。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software connection component for establishing and maintaining a synchronous connection to a LabRAD manager, spawning new connections, creating communication contexts, and sending requests or messages to target services. It is mainly used for service discovery, setting inspection, and inter-process communication in lab automation software, rather than for direct control of a physical instrument.

schema.description: 派生一个连接到同一管理器的新独立连接。
schema.description_en: Spawn a new independent connection to the same manager.

schema.description: 创建一个用于该连接的通信上下文。
schema.description_en: Create a communication context for this connection.

schema.description: 向目标服务发送请求记录并等待响应。
schema.description_en: Send request records to a target service and wait for a response.

schema.description: 向目标服务发送消息记录。
schema.description_en: Send message records to a target service.

schema.description: 获取管理器中可用服务列表。
schema.description_en: Get the list of available services from the manager.
Get information about a specified service.

schema.description: 获取指定服务的设置列表。
schema.description_en: Get the list of settings for a specified service.
Get information about a specified setting.

schema.description: 按名称获取指定设置的信息。
schema.description_en: Get information about a specified setting by name.
